fire-spring-water: Only a calm water surface patch for the distant decorative pool. A very wide shallow ellipse seen from a low side-on angle: upper edge gently curved and horizontal, near edge broad and softly curved. Flat muted grey-green water with just 8 to 12 thin soft broken horizontal ripple strokes, slightly lighter desaturated sage near the middle, darker around the rim. No white highlights. No vertical forms or recognisable reflections. Keep ripples almost horizontal, no concentric circles, no shiny 3D or painted rocks. The plane occupies most of the width and about the central half of the canvas height. No banks, rocks, shore, mist, ground, trees or scenery. This is only the water material shape, independently layerable.
fire-spring-far-bank: Only ONE very wide low ribbon of irregular volcanic rock forming the FAR BANK of a pool, seen from the side. Shallow uneven top contour, 4 or 5 broad rounded fused masses, softly sloped continuous lower contour, approximately 10 times wider than its actual height, centered with generous empty magenta above and below. Medium-dark warm grey, two low-contrast flat tones. Irregular broad rock outlines, not piles of little boulders, not a walkway, no sharp level ledges or platform. No water, no pool basin, no enclosing oval ring, no cave roof, no foreground.
fire-spring-cave-roof: Only ONE wide hanging volcanic cave ceiling slab with an asymmetric arch-shaped underside. Heavy continuous rock across the top, the left and right ends hang lower, while the center underside opens into a broad high shallow vault. Whole outer top contour must also be uncropped with magenta margin. Three large blunt tapering pendant forms maximum, not a row of spikes. Dark charcoal grey with just one slightly lighter broad plane, near-flat silhouette. Read as a hanging ceiling over a cavern, not a bridge, mountain or upward-pointing ridge. Do not draw vertical side walls to the floor, water, ground, distant cave or other layers.
fire-spring-left-wall: Only ONE thick tall LEFT cavern side wall module. Outer LEFT edge is broad and gently uneven; RIGHT-facing inner edge has two massive irregular rounded shoulders and opens inward toward the RIGHT. Bottom is broad and heavy, top narrows slightly with an inward overhang. Almost flat dark charcoal warm grey with one subdued broad plane. Complete uncropped contour and padding, no scenery in the opening. No hole through the rock, no floor platform, no scattered rocks, no water, no far wall, no roof spanning the canvas. This is a vertical wall, not a free-standing thin pillar.
fire-spring-right-wall: Only ONE thick tall RIGHT cavern side wall module, distinct asymmetric design from left. Outer RIGHT edge is broad and gently uneven; LEFT-facing inner edge bows outward toward the LEFT near the top with a heavy rounded overhang, then recedes at middle height and broadens at its base. Dark charcoal warm grey, one subdued broad plane. Complete uncropped contour with padding. No bright edges, no repeated small cracks. No hole through the rock, no floor ledge, no water, no far wall, no roof spanning the canvas. A massive cave side wall, not a thin pillar.
